A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work and contain readable main text and Appendices A–G. Corresponding equations, Tables 1–11, Figures 1–20, and Algorithms 1–2 support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v4 reports original benchmark performance, measured inference speedups, and analyses of expert utilization, with additional experiments and ablations in the appendices.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including language and multimodal evaluations, inference measurements, and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Token Drop, local-expert Expanded Drop, the device-level capacity variant, and modality-specific dropping strategies are unchanged. Algorithms 1–2 retain the same implementation.

E1.justification: The language benchmarks, BANKING77/LongICLBench, HumanEval, NQ-Open, MTS-Dialog, and multimodal benchmarks MME, MMBench, and SEED-Bench are retained. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods, including Order, Reverse Order, Random, and Score in Table 1; Expert Drop in Table 2; and the granularity and dropping-strategy variants in Tables 3–4. Appendix comparator sets also match.

E3.justification: Reported capacity factors, hardware and parallelism settings, Table 5 shot counts and metrics, and appendix sample sizes and workloads are unchanged. The eight-H20 setup sentence moves across pages 6–7 without changing its content.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same capacity sensitivity, workload, maximum-selected-expert, modality-dropping, gating-score, and layer-wise load analyses. Appendices B–D and F–G add no new analyses or ablation conditions in v5.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains the statement that performance is averaged over multiple random seeds. No run counts, uncertainty reporting practices, confidence intervals, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Corresponding numerical results, plotted data, and qualitative findings match throughout both PDFs and their appendices. For example, Table 2 retains Mixtral-8×7B-Instruct averages of 74.3 for the baseline and 74.5 for Expanded Drop.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, load and latency bounds, capacity constraints, Equations 1–11, and device-level constraint are unchanged. No formal result, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and efficiency/performance claims, including the reported 0.2% average improvement and 1.85× speedup for Mixtral Expanded Drop. Wording edits do not change their scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations involving gating-score tails, local communication, image-token redundancy, training-related imbalance, and degradation under aggressive capacity limits remain unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added.

D1.justification: Sections 7–8 replace future release promises with statements that the implementation is released and reproducibility README instructions are provided. Both abstracts already give the same repository link, so this updates the availability disclosure without establishing that repository contents changed. In-PDF implementation details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and bibliography are unchanged. Section 2 receives grammatical edits while retaining the same positioning relative to training-time balancing and inference-time expert duplication.

P1.justification: v5 makes limited grammatical and terminology corrections throughout the existing structure, such as replacing 'there might exists tokens' with 'some tokens may select' and standardizing 'multimodal.' Sections and appendices are not substantially rewritten or reorganized.

P2.justification: Small caption corrections and text/table reflow are visible, including Table 4 and the model-name spellings in Figures 14 and 19. No figure or table is added, removed, or redrawn; graphical data and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v5 modestly improves readability through grammatical corrections and makes Sections 7–8 consistent with the abstract's existing code-release statement. These are limited clarity and consistency gains; the scientific methods and evidence are unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish any improvement to the repository contents.
